content; this boundary always precedes the page's Citations / Similar Documents / Legal Events tables, which list OTHER documents' assignees and are the demonstrated source of at least one fabrication (row n=29, see mismatch_detail).
headline: 5 of 10 audited individual-patent-family rows (n=27..36) carry a fixture 'assignee' field that does not match that row's own cited url's bibliographic assignee data, with no independently-corroborated M&A event explaining the discrepancy (contrast n=33, which DOES have such an event and is excluded from the mismatch count). This extends the R-A13/R-S03 fabrication pattern from claim-chart elements and one compound-label misattribution to plain wrong company names, at a 40% (4/10) error rate in this newly-audited slice.

mismatch_detail.29: Fixture assignee 'Elementis Specialties, Inc.' does not match WO2018010615A1's own bibliographic assignee (current=original='Deuchem Shanghai Chemical Co Ltd'). 'Elementis Specialties, Inc.' DOES appear on the same raw page, but only inside the Citations(4) table as the assignee of a DIFFERENT, merely-cited document (EP1162242A1, 'Rheological additives and paint and coating compositions...'). This is consistent with an extraction bug that read the wrong table on the page, not a typo.
mismatch_detail.31: Fixture assignee 'Monsanto Company' does not match US3178319A's own bibliographic assignee (current=original='GERALDINE D HENRICKS', an individual, not a company). No occurrence of 'Monsanto' appears in this patent's own assignee fields.
mismatch_detail.34: Fixture assignee 'International Paint LLC family' does not match US6391464B1's own bibliographic assignee (current=original='General Electric Co'; title 'Epoxy coatings and surfaces coated therewith' does match the claim1_gist domain, but the assignee chain is a GE/silicone -materials lineage with no International Paint entity in either the current or original assignee fields).
mismatch_detail.36: Fixture assignee 'General Mills Inc.' does not match US2986539A's own bibliographic assignee (original='American Can Co', current='Primerica Inc'). No occurrence of 'General Mills' appears in this patent's own assignee fields, despite family n=35 (US2705223A, same claimed assignee 'General Mills Inc.') being a genuine, verified General Mills Inc. match.

corroboration.event: Air Products Performance Materials Division (incl. epoxy curing agents, ~40% of division revenue) sold to Evonik Industries AG, deal closed 2017-01-03, $3.8B.
corroboration.resolution: corroborated_current_via_independent_ma_event; Google Patents' bibliographic field is stale, not the fixture.
